title: Paramavatar Shri Krishna
desc: Lord Krishna, once a naughty little child, grows up and embarks on a number of adventures to fight and eradicate evil forces and provide justice to all.

title: Bandabudh Aur Budbuk
desc: Two mischievous friends constantly concoct clever tricks and unusual ways to dodge studying at school, while creating chaos for their classmates.

title: Saru
desc: A kabaddi player with aspirations of becoming a district commissioner leaves Rajasthan for Mumbai to attend college, balancing her ambitions while fighting for her mother's rightful family status.
